targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1047 ran the H-mag vs H-pat spike that failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-964b_2026-09-16 pre-registered (amplified-REAL-readout ladder, k in {1,10,40,100} at shipped authority). Its self-routed label deficit_readout_magnitude_limited (H-MAG SUPPORTED) is NOT SUSTAINED, refuted by the run's own cells. (1) F_MAG is real_seeds_firing >= 2 with NO control term (driver L847-853); it is satisfied by the real arm alone. (2) 'Firing' is one diverged committed tick above a 1e-9 floor; the two firing seeds carried exactly 1 tick each (1/96 seed 101, 1/33 seed 202) and seed 71 fired 0/28 at every rung. (3) At the SAME rail rung the controls MATCH OR BEAT the real arm on every seed where it fires: seed 101 real 0.01042 vs synthetic 0.03125 (3x); seed 202 real 0.03030 vs synthetic 0.06061 (2x) and PERMUTED 0.12121 (4x). At k=10 the permuted control fired on a seed majority while the real arm fired zero. Conditioned on reachable flips at k=100 the real arm converts 2/26 (7.7%) against synthetic 19.2% and permuted 15.4%. NO cell at ANY rung has the real arm above BOTH controls. (4) k=40 -> k=100 left the real arm's committed divergence unchanged (1/96, 1/33 at both) while both controls rose. (5) No seed MAJORITY is both at-rail and firing: at-rail {71,202}, firing {101,202}, intersection {202} -- one seed carrying one tick. (Two claims in this autopsy's first draft were withdrawn at the Step 7c pass and are recorded as withdrawn: the at-rail and firing sets are NOT disjoint, and real_clamp_saturated_frac 0.53125 is a maximum over ticks AND seeds occurring on seed 71, which fires nothing, so 'the clamp provably destroys the ordering' is NOT supported at the firing cells -- the clamp collapse remains a live mechanism the driver itself names, but it is not established by that number.) The instrument cannot currently discriminate real ordering from a value-shuffled control, so this run is non-contributory about MECH-482 in either direction. epistemic_category STAYS substrate_conditional; status STAYS candidate; pending_retest_after_substrate STAYS true.

learning_extracted: A finding criterion with no control term cannot establish a finding, however many preconditions are green. F_MAG (real_seeds_firing >= majority) fired at a rung where a VALUE-SHUFFLED control outperformed the real arm 4x on the seed both fired on. The driver already contained the honest branch (inconclusive_controls_did_not_separate) and its text names the collapse mechanism exactly -- branch ORDER let the control-free test pre-empt it.

An outcome field carries no information when 3 of 4 branches emit PASS and PASS is decided by the instrument gate alone. Read the LABEL, and read the criterion behind the label; and treat criteria_non_degenerate entries that are hard-coded literals (L998) as absent rather than as a degeneracy check.

A per-run MAXIMUM is not the run's state. real_clamp_saturated_frac 0.53125 is a max over ticks AND seeds, landing on the seed that fires nothing. This autopsy's own first draft misused it and the Step 7c pass caught it.
